shortDescription: GETTYSBURG, Pa., Oct. 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- ACNB Corporation NASDAQ:ACNB, financial holding company for ACNB Bank and ACNB Insurance Services, Inc., announced today that the Board of Directors has declared both a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.46 per share and a special cash dividend…

children: , financial holding company for ACNB Bank and ACNB Insurance Services, Inc., announced today that the Board of Directors has declared both a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.46 per share and a special cash dividend of $0.75 per share on the Corporation's common stock.

The regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.46 per share represents an increase of 9.5% from the quarterly cash dividend of $0.42 per share paid in the prior quarter. Combined with the special cash dividend of $0.75 per share, shareholders will receive total cash dividends of $1.21 per share. Both the regular quarterly cash dividend and the special cash dividend will be payable on December 15, 2026, to shareholders of record as of December 1, 2026.

"Our Board's decision to approve both a quarterly dividend increase and a special dividend reflects the exceptional financial strength our Company has demonstrated over the past several years," said James P. Helt, President and Chief Executive Officer of ACNB Corporation. "This marks the second increase to our regular dividend and our second special dividend in 2026, underscoring our commitment to delivering meaningful returns to shareholders while maintaining the capital, liquidity, and balance sheet strength necessary to support future growth and continue serving our communities."

ACNB Corporation has a long-standing history of providing returns to shareholders through regular cash dividends while maintaining a conservative approach to capital management and supporting future growth opportunities. Including these declared dividends, ACNB Corporation will have paid total cash dividends of $2.93 per share during 2026, consisting of $1.68 in regular cash dividends and $1.25 in special cash dividends. The total amount of dividends that will be paid per share in 2026 represents an increase of approximately 112% over the $1.38 per share paid in 2025.

ACNB Corporation, headquartered in Gettysburg, PA, is the independent $3.30 billion financial holding company for the wholly-owned subsidiaries of ACNB Bank, Gettysburg, PA, including its operating divisions Traditions Bank and Traditions Mortgage, and ACNB Insurance Services, Inc., Westminster, MD. Originally founded in 1857, ACNB Bank serves its marketplace with banking and wealth management services, including trust and retail brokerage, via a network of 33 community banking offices and two Limited Purpose Offices located in the Pennsylvania counties of Adams, Cumberland, Franklin, Lancaster, York, and Berks and the Maryland counties of Baltimore, Carroll and Frederick. ACNB Insurance Services, Inc. is a full-service insurance agency with licenses in 46 states. The agency offers a broad range of property, casualty, health, life and disability insurance serving personal and commercial clients through office locations in Westminster, MD, and Gettysburg, PA. For more information regarding ACNB Corporation and its subsidiaries, please visit investor.acnb.com.
